name: Will Democrats win control of the U.S. Senate in the 2026 midterms?
description:
Yes if Democrats, counting independents who caucus with them, hold 51 or more Senate seats when the new Congress convenes Jan 3, 2027. A 50-50 split resolves No (VP Vance breaks ties). Currently 53 R - 47 D.

Resolves on the Associated Press race call. If AP never calls the race, resolves on the state's certified result. Trading closes the morning of election day (Nov 3). Annulled if the election is cancelled or postponed past 2027.

name: Will Democrats win control of the U.S. House in the 2026 midterms?
description:
Yes if Democrats win 218 or more of the 435 House seats in the Nov 3, 2026 election, counted from the final AP seat tally. Currently 218 R - 214 D - 1 I, 2 vacant.

Resolves on the Associated Press race call. If AP never calls the race, resolves on the state's certified result. Trading closes the morning of election day (Nov 3). Annulled if the election is cancelled or postponed past 2027.

name: Will Democrats win both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterms?
description:
Yes only if both of the previous two conditions hold: Democrats win 218+ House seats AND hold 51+ Senate seats (incl. caucusing independents). Anything else resolves No.
